test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters which, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_ L _ _ K S _ T U _ S L _ _ K

options.text: L U S K T U K
U T S K T L U
S T U L K T U
K T U L U T S

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: _ L _ _ K S _ T U _ S L _ _ K 

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) L U S K T U K → **__L__** L **__U__** **__S__** K / S **__K__** T U **__T__** / S L **__U__** __K__
